evidence.text: Pipeline Harbor plans start at $29/mo for up to 5 seats and go up to $99/mo for the Team plan with unlimited seats. A 14-day free trial is available, no credit card required.
Core features include contact management, a visual deal pipeline, automated email sequencing, and a mobile app for iOS and Android.
Pipeline Harbor is used primarily by small B2B sales teams of 10-50 employees in North America.
Pipeline Harbor announced an $8M Series A funding round led by a growth-stage venture fund.
